reason: #3118 adds ten container_only Z-Wave tests (TestZwaveNetwork in tests/src/e2e/tools/test_radio_management.py): they run Core's zwave_js integration against a Z-Wave JS server in a sidecar container on Docker's bridge, which a HAOS VM does not reach. Every HAOS lane gains ten collection-time skips; the testcontainer lanes run them.
